Thanks for sharing the demo. The video is helpful for showing that the
implementation works end-to-end, but I think the main question is less
about whether it functions and more about the trade-offs of moving
everything to a single canvas-based system. It would be useful to discuss
any benefits, limitations, and potential regressions compared to the
current approach so the team can evaluate whether the architectural change
is worth pursuing.
